public.text: Section 4.6.3 mentions private hosting and app development "bounded so government retains ownership," but doesn't name the underlying risk.
public.suggestedRevision: Recommend adding a country-driven principle, cautioning against firms using country engagements to access markets without delivering measurable country benefit.  (Worth noting section 5.4.4 warns against vendor and donor pressure to invest in AI before foundations are ready, but that's about premature investment and not about first principles of engagement. Also, only the AI-specific caution appears.)
